commits.message:
chore: move cargo-cost-lint to edition 2024 and collapse nested if-let chain into let-chains

- Bump cargo-cost-lint edition from 2021 to 2024 to match soroban_cost_lints
- Replace three-deep nested if let block in config parsing with let-chains
  (if let ... && let ... && let ...), matching the convention described
  in CONTRIBUTING.md and the style already used in soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs
- Extract config_path binding to avoid calling resolve_config twice
- Minor UX improvement: read errors now produce a warning instead of
  being silently swallowed

Closes #83
